citation: Poggio, L., de Sousa, L. M., Batjes, N. H., Heuvelink, G. B. M., Kempen, B., Ribeiro, E., and Rossiter, D. (2021). SoilGrids 2.0: producing soil information for the globe with quantified spatial uncertainty. SOIL, 7, 217–240. https://doi.org/10.5194/soil-7-217-2021
wcs_request: WCS 2.0.1 GetCoverage; WGS84 subset reprojected to EPSG:152160
coverage: WGS84 request extent longitude 76–81°E and latitude 8–14°N; includes Tamil Nadu and adjacent areas and is not clipped to the state boundary.

grid.output_crs: Interrupted Goode Homolosine (WCS output CRS URI EPSG:152160)

nodata_convention: The downloaded WCS GeoTIFFs do not declare a NoData tag. Zero-valued pixels are treated as unavailable, not as soil measurements.

limitations: A modelled SoilGrids pixel, not a field or laboratory measurement.
Use as a contextual estimate only; verify with a field soil test before agronomic decisions.
No uncertainty raster is included in this extract, so no cell-specific confidence interval is reported.

total_nitrogen.raw_encoding: SoilGrids nitrogen layer value in centigrams per kilogram
limitations: This total-nitrogen concentration is not a validated equivalent of the crop model's N feature; it is excluded from model inputs.
A modelled SoilGrids pixel, not a field or laboratory measurement.

clay_content.raw_encoding: Clay mass fraction in grams per kilogram of fine earth
limitations: A modelled SoilGrids pixel, not a field or laboratory measurement.
Texture fractions are context only and are not crop-model inputs.

sand_content.raw_encoding: Sand mass fraction in grams per kilogram of fine earth
limitations: A modelled SoilGrids pixel, not a field or laboratory measurement.
Texture fractions are context only and are not crop-model inputs.

silt_content.raw_encoding: Silt mass fraction in grams per kilogram of fine earth
limitations: A modelled SoilGrids pixel, not a field or laboratory measurement.
Texture fractions are context only and are not crop-model inputs.

soil_organic_carbon.raw_encoding: Soil organic carbon in decigrams per kilogram; converted to grams per kilogram
limitations: A modelled SoilGrids pixel, not a field or laboratory measurement.
No soil organic-carbon feature exists in the trained crop model.
